items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bob, you go in the studio with him and show him how it’s done... I said to Bob Stevens in New York one day... I never said anything about getting paid. I’d like to know what I’m going to get paid.

ctx.x: Slightly, yeah. I’ll cover that in a bit. Unfortunately I didn’t do anything about it. I was in awe.

So the idea came about to make not only an album of Chicago jazz, but also New Orleans and Kansas City. I proposed that in a long letter to Decca Records, which was the company that started putting together reissue albums way ahead of everybody else. They did it in the form of six 50-cent records in a six-pocket, ten-inch album. They charged 50 cents as a premium to cover the cost of the album, or maybe they charged 50 cents more for the album. They did it this way. Bing Crosby did a movie called Blue Hawaii.…
